contradictions.promise: Project help and metadata advertise a zero-to-GitHub, multi-language orchestrator.
contradictions.actual: The native project-init helper creates only a local Python scaffold and an optional local commit.

contradictions.promise: Project help says project-init installs Power Pack state, hooks, and Spec Kit automatically.
contradictions.actual: The native skill correctly delegates publication, Spec Kit adoption, issue sync, and persistent influence to separate workflows.

contradictions.promise: Every parsed Spec Kit task becomes a useful, independently actionable GitHub issue.
contradictions.actual: The duplicate helpers emit one low-context issue per matching line and silently ignore malformed task-like lines.

contradictions.promise: Spec Kit adoption follows a durable upstream boundary.
contradictions.actual: spec-adopt currently installs from the moving upstream repository without a reviewed release pin.

composition.rationale: Readiness analysis and GitHub issue compilation add capabilities after official authoring; they do not replace core Spec Kit commands or templates.

rejected.reason: A preset would override or compose core authoring files and create an unnecessary fork of the official workflow.
A bundle only distributes multiple primitives; it is unnecessary until CxPP has more than the single issue-compilation extension to compose.
A substitute .specify scaffold would drift from the pinned official Codex integration.

checks.failure: The selected feature must contain a non-empty .specify/specs/<feature>/tasks.md with canonical task identifiers.
The official consistency analysis must report no unresolved errors across spec, plan, and tasks.
Unresolved template markers, empty required sections, and placeholder tests block compilation.
Implementation tasks must name exact repository-relative paths or explicitly identify path discovery as their outcome.
Every issue group must carry an independently runnable acceptance checkpoint and quality commands.
Cross-group prerequisites and blockers must be explicit and acyclic.
The analyzed artifact set and proposed grouping require explicit approval before GitHub writes.

issue_compilation.immutable_links: Use GitHub blob URLs pinned to the approved artifact commit for spec.md, plan.md, and tasks.md.
issue_compilation.mapping_write_back: Update the selected tasks.md Issue Sync ledger with stable group identity, issue number, URL, and state after successful synchronization.

responsibilities: Provide the deterministic project-next models, collector, ranking core, and structured uncertainty boundary consumed by the mapping integration.
Leave stable mapping consumption to issue #160 because #158 merged before the prerequisite contract.
acceptance_evidence: PR #167 merged the deterministic foundation and closed #158 while issue #166 was in progress.

responsibilities: Align project-init skill, metadata, help, manifest, and prompts to the local-only default.
Make project-init explicit-only and enforce negative routing.
acceptance_evidence: Fresh prompt inventory contains no contradictory project-init promises.

responsibilities: Implement pinned Spec Kit adoption and the CxPP extension boundary.
Make spec-sync the only issue compiler and implement readiness, grouping, rich bodies, idempotency, and mapping write-back.
Replace project-next task-ID heuristics with stable mapping consumption and mapped dependency handling.
Retire every duplicate helper recorded by this contract.
acceptance_evidence: Invalid artifacts fail loudly and approved artifacts compile into dependency-aware Flow issues.

responsibilities: Test positive and negative routing, scaffold consent, artifact parsing, grouping, rich bodies, idempotency, and end-to-end handoff.
acceptance_evidence: Evaluation results distinguish routing, artifact, parser, grouping, body, mapping, and runtime failures.

responsibilities: Keep AGENTS.md guidance, hooks, permissions, trust, and plugin state behind the separate cxpp-init consent boundary.
acceptance_evidence: Declining persistent influence leaves only the ordinary local scaffold.

responsibilities: Document migration and prove a clean-project workflow against immutable releases.
Keep task-granular synchronization an explicit compatibility option.
acceptance_evidence: Dogfood demonstrates actionable, sequenced issues without hidden publication, installation, or persistence.
